top.line: Yiheng Wang's site, made in three passes in one evening, with five designs and every claim sourced.
top.para: The factory, five design agents, then her own agent.

in-short.line: A site that is her; three passes; five designs; agents three ways; made to hire; nothing made up; full circle.

who.line: Project manager at Web Summit, PrompTugal.news editor, ran 26 agents with no technical background; looking for a role.
who.para: She agreed to the site and to be named.

passes.line: The factory in 72 seconds and a first version in 3.5 minutes; five design agents in 11 minutes; then her own agent.
passes.para: Each pass read the guidance the last one left.

designs.line: The Profile, Mission Control, The Pass, The Brief and The Journey: the same facts, five ways.
designs.para: With a picker; each rebuilt for phones.

team.line: Her 26 agents as a live network, a constellation and a kitchen brigade.
team.para: Her own analogy, as a diagram.

kitchen.line: A prep list, ticket 027 with 15 + 12 = 27, a five-course menu and a reservation card.

control.line: Decisions as an incident log, lessons as rules, and her path in numbered chapters.

hire.line: A printable brief with evidence and interview questions, and a page telling your AI how to ask about her.
hire.para: Instructions for hiring managers, Yiheng, her AI and editors.

her.line: Nothing made up: every figure names its source, and she can talk about each because she did it.

circle.line: It worked because of agents that read our guidance, the factory, behaviour policies, public work and a handover.
circle.para: And it is a template now.

limits.line: The site keeps changing; timings from commits and status; figures are the site's own; she has the last word.

sources.line: The live site, its repository, the factory requests, her interview and earlier articles.
